Idaho Batholith.label_method: proximity (no DEM elevation cut — Idaho has no regional DEM in this repo)
Idaho Batholith.note: Frozen NE Washington forest scored on Idaho Batholith NURE. Transfer AUC is ~0.50 (coin flip). Tightening the gold circle to 0.05° does not rescue it. 0.15° labels most of this box because Idaho County is painted with gold MRDS pins — that is a weak negative class, not a reason to call the doorbell national. This is a transfer test, not a new model.

ca_sierra_placer.label_method: proximity (no DEM elevation cut — this belt has no regional DEM in this repo)
ca_sierra_placer.note: Frozen NE Washington forest scored on California Sierra placer foothills NURE. Transfer AUC is 0.52 (coin flip — the forest does not travel). Tightening the gold circle to 0.05° gives 0.61. 0.15° labels most of this box because gold MRDS pins are dense — that is a weak negative class. Mean P is flat near gold and far from it. This is a transfer test, not a new model. Do not call the doorbell national.

mt_placer.note: Frozen NE Washington forest scored on Montana SW gold gulches NURE. Transfer AUC is 0.34 (coin flip — the forest does not travel). Tightening the gold circle to 0.05° gives 0.33. 0.15° labels most of this box because gold MRDS pins are dense — that is a weak negative class. Mean P is higher far from gold than next to it. This is a transfer test, not a new model. Do not call the doorbell national.
